title: Bundle category, Aura MC hero/branding enhancements, and INR cart subtotal in header

requirements.summary: Add a new top-level "Bundle" store category and make it navigable like existing categories.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage shows a fifth primary navigation tile/card labeled "Bundle" alongside the existing four categories.
Clicking "Bundle" navigates to a category page like other categories (same route pattern).

file_operations.description: Add a new top-level category with id "bundle" and name "Bundle" so it appears alongside existing categories.
Ensure the category tiles grid comfortably supports 5 tiles and add an icon mapping entry for the new "bundle" category so the tile renders consistently.

requirements.summary: Implement the Bundle catalog as a single ₹1750 purchasable item with the specified included rewards and validity note, fully cart-compatible.
acceptanceCriteria: The catalog data includes a new category with id "bundle" and name "Bundle".
The Bundle category contains exactly one purchasable item priced at ₹1750.
The Bundle item display includes the included rewards list: "5🔑 Top Keys", "3 Months Top Rank", "750🪙 Coins", "10M 💸 Money" and a note: "Valid in any 1 realm" (English, same meaning).
The Bundle item can be added to cart and behaves like all other products (quantity increases if added multiple times, removable, included in totals).

file_operations.description: Add exactly one Bundle product priced at 1750 (INR) and include structured display text for rewards ("5🔑 Top Keys", "3 Months Top Rank", "750🪙 Coins", "10M 💸 Money") plus the note "Valid in any 1 realm" via optional product metadata fields.
Extend product rendering to show the Bundle item’s included rewards list and validity note when present, while keeping add-to-cart behavior identical to other products.

requirements.summary: Add prominent "Farm the Aura" hero copy in a premium/professional display style on the homepage.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage hero shows "Farm the Aura" as a prominent headline/sub-headline in addition to the existing Aura MC Store title and the "Happy Gaming" / "Happy Shopping" lines.

file_operations.description: Update the hero section to include the phrase "Farm the Aura" as a prominent headline/sub-headline using a high-quality display styling aligned with the current Tailwind theme.

requirements.summary: Add subtle, professional Aura MC branding animations in the homepage hero and persistent header without harming usability/performance.
acceptanceCriteria: Aura MC brand element(s) (logo and/or "Aura MC" text) have a subtle animation (e.g., float, shimmer, glow pulse) visible on the homepage and in the persistent header.
Animations do not interfere with navigation, form inputs, or reading product/cart/checkout details.

file_operations.description: Add lightweight keyframes/animation utilities for subtle branding effects (e.g., slow float/glow) suitable for motion-safe usage.
Apply subtle motion-safe animation classes to the Aura MC logo and/or brand text in the persistent header while preserving layout stability and click targets.
Apply subtle motion-safe animation classes to Aura MC branding elements within the hero (e.g., logo) ensuring readability and performance.

requirements.summary: Show the current cart subtotal formatted in ₹ in the header cart entry point when cart is not empty, while keeping the item count badge.
acceptanceCriteria: When cart has items, the header shows a cart entry point that includes the subtotal formatted in INR (₹) next to the cart icon/button.
When cart is empty, the header cart entry point does not show a misleading ₹ amount (may show just the icon or ₹0 depending on existing design, but must be clear).
The existing cart item count badge continues to work.

file_operations.description: Compute cart subtotal from the Zustand cart store and display it formatted via the existing INR formatter next to the cart icon/button only when cart is non-empty, keeping the existing count badge behavior.
